model.name: merge.saveGuardedOrJump
model.description: Save only actually SAVES when there are 0 open conflicts (all resolved). If conflicts REMAIN, pressing Save instead JUMPS to the next UNRESOLVED conflict (guides the user), NOT saving. Rides RbDiffEditor.save (R30.38 Method 11a8ea6e / Impl a88b2b53) + jumpToChange (R30.36 6a4b95fe) + the unresolved count (R30.36 openChangeCount / R30.37 resolved-state 5abdb2d4).
